headline: An interactive launch-scenario planner that reshapes the TS epidemiology funnel and the specialist channel footprint. Every output is expressed in patients and channel/access coverage only — never dollars, revenue, market penetration, or claims.
disclaimer: Neutral commercial-intelligence model spec. Outputs are directional, literature- and registry-anchored, and reported in patients and channel/access terms only. No pricing, revenue, penetration %, dollars, or claims-level modeling. Every base rate cites a primary source; verify the live source before external use. Not medical advice or promotional material.

base_rates.label: True TS prevalence incl. undiagnosed (~1 in 162)
base_rates.note: Community-screening prevalence when diagnosed + undiagnosed cases are both counted.

base_rates.label: Diagnosed TS prevalence (~1 in 333)
base_rates.note: Parent-reported NSCH diagnosed prevalence; the market visible today.

base_rates.label: Diagnosed US children with TS (2016-2019)
base_rates.note: Empirical anchor for the diagnosed pool; all downstream patient outputs build from this count, not from a raw denominator multiply.

base_rates.label: Children with TS incl. undiagnosed — model estimate (~2x diagnosed)
base_rates.note: Model estimate: about twice the ~174,000 diagnosed, reflecting that ~half of children with TS are undiagnosed. This is the diagnosis-lift ceiling. (Distinct from CDC's published all-ages figure of 350,000-450,000 children AND adults.)

base_rates.label: Share of children with TS who are undiagnosed
base_rates.note: Roughly half of children who have TS have never been formally diagnosed; the gap the diagnosis-lift lever closes.

base_rates.label: Moderate-to-severe / drug-warranting minority of diagnosed TS
base_rates.note: Most tics are mild, wax-and-wane, and managed by watchful waiting or CBIT; only a moderate-to-severe minority warrants pharmacotherapy per the AAN natural-history framing. 20% used as the base-case point estimate.

base_rates.label: CBIT much/very-much improved (vs 18.5% control; NNT=3)
base_rates.note: First-line behavioral response rate; frames the CBIT gate that sits ahead of a pharmacotherapy decision. Access, not efficacy, is the binding constraint in practice.

base_rates.label: TAA Centers of Excellence (Feb 2025 count; 1+ added 2026)
base_rates.note: National count of designated Centers of Excellence; the channel anchor and the CoE-only reach floor. Confirm the live roster before external use.

base_rates.label: US children insured by Medicaid/CHIP
base_rates.note: Pediatric = heavy public-payer exposure; access is won state Medicaid program by state Medicaid program, which conditions the step-therapy lever.

base_rates.label: Professional types consulted before TS diagnosis
base_rates.note: Referral churn and diagnostic delay sit ahead of specialist reach; part of why the diagnosed pool trails true prevalence.

levers.label: Diagnosis-rate lift (closing the undiagnosed gap)
levers.description: Fraction of the currently-undiagnosed TS pool that gets formally identified over the planning horizon. Scales the diagnosed pool up from today's ~50% of true prevalence toward 100%. At 0% the diagnosed pool stays at ~174,000 children; at 100% it approaches the full ~348,000 true-prevalence pool. Moves patients from the latent pool into the diagnosed, drug-warranting pool — no dollar effect implied.
levers.affects: Scales diagnosed_children up toward true_ts_children; feeds diagnosed_dw_pool (up) and latent_dw_pool (down).

levers.label: CBIT-access constraint
levers.description: Share of drug-warranting patients who can actually access guideline-first CBIT. AAN places CBIT first-line; where it is unavailable (therapist shortage) patients route toward pharmacotherapy sooner, and where it is available patients are held at the behavioral gate first. Modeled purely as patient sequencing/routing — never as substitution economics or cost offset.
levers.unit: % of drug-warranting patients with CBIT access
levers.affects: Sets cbit_first_gated (share routed through behavioral therapy before a pharmacotherapy decision); does not remove patients from the pool, only sequences them.

levers.label: Step-therapy stringency (generics to fail first)
levers.description: Number of generic agents (alpha-2 agonists such as guanfacine/clonidine, and generic antipsychotics) a payer requires a patient to fail before a novel branded agent is reachable. Each required step attrites the near-term addressable pool. 0 = open access; 3 = fail three generics first. Given ~49% pediatric Medicaid/CHIP exposure, stringency is set state Medicaid program by state Medicaid program.
levers.affects: Attrites diagnosed_dw_pool per required step to produce branded_reachable_pool (patients only).

levers.label: CoE-first vs community reach
levers.description: Channel-breadth dial from CoE-concentrated (narrow, high-conviction — the 28+ TAA Centers of Excellence) to broad community pediatric-neurology and child-psychiatry reach. Higher = a wider specialist footprint beyond the CoE core, expanding the specialist-reachable share of the drug-warranting pool. At 0 only the CoE floor is reachable.
levers.unit: reach breadth (0 = CoE-only, 100 = full community specialist footprint)
levers.affects: Sets specialist_reachable_share (breadth) and the coe_covered_share floor.

levers.label: Austedo-field coordination / share-of-voice
levers.description: Degree to which Teva's existing movement-disorder / neuroscience field organization (built around Austedo, which failed the ARTISTS trials and carries no TS indication) is coordinated onto tic-treating specialists. A share-of-voice / call-point-coverage dial that scales how much of the reachable specialist footprint is actively covered. Strategic routing only — no dollars, share-of-market, or revenue overlap is modeled; the internal tension is share-of-voice, not revenue.
levers.affects: Coverage multiplier applied within specialist_reachable_share (how much of the reachable footprint is actually called on).

levers.label: Pediatric-label timing / launch phase-in
levers.description: Commercial-availability phase-in of the pediatric label. FDA accepted the NDA with Priority Review on Aug 19, 2026, with a target action date in late Q1 2027 — so approval is not yet granted and launch cannot precede that decision. 0 = not yet available (today's state; addressable pool = 0); 100 = fully launched, so the diagnosed drug-warranting pool is addressable. Use it to phase the funnel in after a potential approval; it does not assert that approval will occur.
levers.affects: Phase-in fraction applied to all downstream addressable pools (diagnosed_dw_pool, branded_reachable_pool, specialist_reachable_share).

outputs.label: Diagnosed drug-warranting pediatric pool
outputs.formula_note: diagnosed_children lifted by diagnosis_rate_lift toward true_ts_children, times drug_warranting_share (~20% base case). Base case ≈ 174,000 x ~20% ≈ ~35,000 children before access filters. Patients only — no dollars, penetration, or claims.

outputs.label: Latent (undiagnosed) drug-warranting pool
outputs.formula_note: (true_ts_children - diagnosed_children) x (1 - diagnosis_rate_lift/100) x drug_warranting_share. The still-undiagnosed, drug-warranting children the diagnosis lever has not yet unlocked (~348,000 - ~174,000 = ~174,000 latent TS x ~20% ≈ ~35,000 at 0% lift). Patients only.

outputs.label: Held at the CBIT-first behavioral gate
outputs.formula_note: diagnosed_dw_pool x cbit_access_constraint. Patients routed through first-line CBIT before a pharmacotherapy decision. A sequencing gate, not a lost pool — counted in patients, never as cost offset.

outputs.label: Specialist-reachable share of the drug-warranting pool
outputs.formula_note: coe_vs_community_reach breadth x field_coordination_sov coverage, applied to diagnosed_dw_pool and phased by pediatric_label_timing. Channel reach in patients/percent only — no revenue or market-share meaning.

outputs.label: CoE-covered share
outputs.formula_note: Portion of the specialist-reachable pool anchored at the 28+ TAA Centers of Excellence; equals the reach floor when coe_vs_community_reach = 0 and dilutes as community breadth widens. Coverage accounting in patients/percent, not dollars.

outputs.label: Branded-reachable pool after step-therapy
outputs.formula_note: diagnosed_dw_pool attrited by step_therapy_stringency (each required generic-failure step removes a share) and gated by pediatric_label_timing phase-in. Access/channel accounting expressed strictly in patients — never revenue, penetration %, price, or claims.

guardrail: Outputs are expressed ONLY in patients and channel/access-coverage terms. This planner never models pricing, revenue, market penetration %, dollars, or claims-level data. The sliders reshape the epidemiology funnel (diagnosis, severity, behavioral-gate sequencing) and the specialist channel footprint (CoE vs community reach, field coverage, step-therapy attrition, launch phase-in) and nothing more. Base rates are literature/registry-anchored and cited to primary sources. Any dollar, price, or share-of-market figure is out of scope by design (Principle 1).
